title: Home
subtitle: Drag files onto the window, choose them here, or press {{shortcut}} to start a job.

dropzone.title: Drop files to print
dropzone.formatList: PDF, images (JPG, PNG, TIFF, BMP, WebP, HEIC), Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, TXT, RTF, HTML and Markdown
dropzone.folders: Folders work too — you decide whether subfolders are included.
dropzone.action: Drop files to print, or click to choose them

cli.copyFailed: Could not reach the clipboard — select the command and copy it manually.

recent.label: Recent activity
recent.empty: No recent activity yet — finished jobs will appear here.
recent.unavailable: Finished jobs live in the desktop app — run MaeclyPrint to see them here.
recent.errorTitle: Recent activity could not be read
recent.errorHint: Nothing was lost — the jobs are still in the desktop app.

shortcuts.label: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: These work from any screen, except while you are typing in a field.
shortcuts.printNeedsFiles: Add files to the job first, then print.
shortcuts.nothingToCancel: No job is printing or waiting right now.

cancelConfirm.title: Cancel this job?
cancelConfirm.message: {{file}} will stop and move to Cancelled. Pages already sent to the printer cannot be pulled back.

tip.label: Tip
tip.body: MaeclyPrint already prints from the command line: {{command}} works without opening the window. The Explorer and Finder right-click entry is not part of this build yet — it arrives with the shell-integration milestone.

welcome.title: Welcome to MaeclyPrint
welcome.body: Open source batch printing for Windows and Mac. No 15-file limit, no Adobe required, no $149 license fee.

printers.title: Detect your printers
printers.body: We'll list every printer your system has installed — including 'Microsoft Print to PDF' on Windows and 'Save as PDF' on Mac.

cli.title: Print without the window
cli.body: The same binary is a command-line tool: {{command}} queues a batch headlessly, with stable exit codes for your scripts.

profiles.title: Pick a default profile
profiles.body: {{name}} is the default profile. Edit it, or add your own, from the Profiles screen.

ready.title: Ready to print
ready.body: Drag any number of files onto the window or press {{shortcut}}, pick a profile, and watch them queue up. A right-click entry in Explorer and Finder is planned for a later milestone.
